facts.text: blue-doorenv-v1 is registered with entry point doorenv2.envs:DoorEnvBlueV1 and max_episode_steps=512
DoorEnvBlueV1 is defined in doorenv_blue.py as a DoorEnv subclass
DoorEnvBlueV1 passes world_path to DoorEnv; the constructor default is /home/demo/DoorGym/world_generator/world/pull_floatinghook
DoorEnv sets self.xml_path = self.random_world(world_path)
random_world chooses one entry of world_path with random.choice(os.listdir(world_path))
For a world file whose name contains gripper and not float or mobile, DoorEnv sets nn to 8
frame_skip is 20
DoorEnv.step advances the simulation with do_simulation(a, self.frame_skip)
The pull_blue_right_v2_gripper_motor world includes the gripper-motor robot and sets the MuJoCo timestep to 0.001 s
The gripper-motor robot has seven joint motors with ctrlrange -1.0 to 1.0
The right_gripper_joint position actuator of that robot has ctrlrange 0 to 1.05
The gripper-motor robot defines twelve actuators: seven joint motors and five position actuators
DoorEnv initialises gripper_action with four zeros
For a gripper world DoorEnv builds the action Box from model.actuator_ctrlrange with the last gripper_space bounds removed
DoorEnvBlueV1.gripper_action_gen builds four finger commands from the last action value
DoorEnv._get_obs concatenates get_robot_joints and get_dist_vec when vision is off
DoorEnvBlueV1.get_robot_joints returns the first nn qpos and qvel values
get_dist_vec is get_finger_target minus get_knob_target
get_finger_target averages the positions of the fingerleft2 and fingerright2 geoms for a gripper world
get_knob_target averages the positions of door_knob_2 and door_knob_3 for a pull world
DoorEnv.step returns (observation, reward, done, info) with done False
For gripper worlds the control penalty is -mean(square(a[:-2]))
reset_model draws the hooked and untucked chances with np.random.randint(100)
The non-float, non-mobile reset sets the first seven joint qpos from uniform(-0.1, 0.1) and draws the two-value pull goal from np_random.uniform(-0.15, 0.15)
The training utility installs an observation Box of nn*2+3 values

determinism.notes: the upstream reset draws from numpy's global generator (np.random) and the environment's np_random; gym's Env.seed sets that generator.  This package's fake draws from Python's random.Random, so one seed repeats on the fake but gives a different trajectory than upstream's numpy stream

gaps: the fake backend is a pure-Python analytic stand-in, not MuJoCo: it has no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuator forces, sensors or noise; its integration, start values and reward are placeholders, not the model's

the fake models the generated world world_generator/world/pull_blue_right_v2_gripper_motor, whose robot has an eight-value action Box; upstream random_world chooses a random XML from world_path, and DoorEnv installs an action space only when that file name contains gripper, so another world directory gives another action dimension or no action space at all

the upstream environment publishes no observation_space; gym's training utility replaces it with a zero-width Box of nn*2+3 values, so the bridge derives no observation schema and the fake returns 19 values with no observation bounds
the fake reproduces the registered max_episode_steps=512 as a legacy four-tuple done flag at tick 512; the environment itself never sets done True, gym's TimeLimit wrapper applies the limit
the fake was never compared with the upstream environment: gym 0.14, mujoco-py and mjremote are not installed where the gate runs, and the sim backend was not run
the env constructor's default world_path is an absolute placeholder (/home/demo/DoorGym/...) that does not exist in the clone; a deployment must supply a generated world directory
no physical robot or door is modelled and the simulator was never validated against hardware
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop the runtime refuses step and reset until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the last world state stays readable
